name: Brett's BBQ
notes: not_found: permanently closed. The Coast News (independent local journalism, not a directory) reported Aug 23 2018 that Brett's BBQ at 1505 Encinitas Blvd, Encinitas was closing for good on Sept 29 2018 after its lease was terminated, matching the batch address exactly. Yelp's own listing title now reads "BRETTS BBQ - CLOSED". No re-opening or successor at this address found.

name: Red Ribbon Bakeshop
notes: batch-listed website (locations.redribbonbakeshop.com) is a franchise-locator/marketing page, not a priced menu, but confirmed this specific Mira Mesa branch (8955 Mira Mesa Blvd) is on DoorDash with a full location-specific JSON-LD menu (11 categories, 80 items) rather than the chain default. Address matches the DoorDash listing exactly. Grubhub itself is JS-walled to curl, but Google's indexed snippet of the same Grubhub store page independently names 4 overlapping cake-slice items at identical prices (Tiramisu Slice $6.61, Ube Overload Slice $6.61, Yema Caramel Slice $5.99, Mango Supreme Slice $5.99), cross-checking the DoorDash data. The "Most Ordered" section held 12 items not duplicated elsewhere in the categorized menu, so all were kept rather than dropped as a carousel duplicate.
